question: Why do those established in well-practiced knowledge have no concern at death?
premises: Some practitioners are made of well-practiced knowledge and are always of the nature of Shiva.
They are indeed liberated while living.
For them there is no deliberation at all at the time of death.
inference: Because the jivanmuktas are already established in Shiva-nature, death introduces no new spiritual issue requiring deliberation.
plain_english: But those who are made of well-practiced knowledge and are always of the nature of Shiva are indeed liberated while living; for them there is no deliberation at all at death.
